name: What should I look for when choosing a garage conversion builder?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a garage conversion builder?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a garage conversion builder, look for experience with similar projects and a strong portfolio of completed work. Verify their licensing, insurance, and ask for references from past clients. A good builder should also be familiar with local zoning laws and permitting requirements in your specific area, such as Los Angeles, and provide clear communication and detailed estimates.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a garage conversion builder with proven experience, proper licensing, insurance, strong references, and local regulatory knowledge.
